tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
The Signal Fire ZSQ-09 9 in 1 Optical Fiber Stripper is a multifunctional tool designed for professional fiber optic technicians and network installers. This compact tool combines several essential functions, including optical fiber stripping, wire cutting, and fiber preparation, helping reduce the need to carry multiple separate tools.


Its durable construction and practical design make it suitable for FTTH installation, fiber optic splicing, telecommunications, data communication, and general fiber network maintenance. The ergonomic design provides convenient handling during installation and repair work.


Key Features


  • 9-in-1 multifunctional fiber optic hand tool
  • Designed for optical fiber stripping and preparation
  • Integrated Miller-style scissors
  • Wire cutting and plier functions
  • Compact and portable design
  • Suitable for fiber optic installation and maintenance
  • Useful for FTTH and telecommunications applications
  • Helps simplify fiber preparation work
  • Suitable for professional technicians and network installers
  • Durable construction for regular field use
